ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN
if :global.question_code != :valid_hh_questions.question_code then
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C10',
 :global.question_code||
 ',','D',chk); 

end if;
IF :global.question_code = :valid_hh_questions.question_code
THEN
 null;
ELSE
 if :valid_hh_questions.question_code is not null then
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM valid_hh_questions
 WHERE question_code = :valid_hh_questions.question_code and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else 
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C10',
 :valid_hh_questions.question_code||
 ',','U',chk); 
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :system.record_status = 'CHANGED' then
 if counter > 1 then
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C10',
 :valid_hh_questions.question_code||
 ',','U',chk); 
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 END IF; /* record status check end*/
 end if; /* 1st if then */
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE retrieve_data IS
chk boolean;
begin
go_block('valid_hh_questions');
clear_block(no_validate);
if :ctrl_block.search_for is not null
 then
 if :ctrl_block.question_code is not null
 then
 set_block_property('valid_hh_questions',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'upper(question_description) like ''%''||upper(:ctrl_block.search_for)||''%'' and
 question_code = :ctrl_block.question_code');
 else
 set_block_property('valid_hh_questions',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'upper(question_description) like ''%''||upper(:ctrl_block.search_for)||''%''');
 end if; 
 else
 if :ctrl_block.question_code is not null
 then 
 set_block_property('valid_hh_questions',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'question_code = :ctrl_block.question_code');
 end if;
end if;
go_block('valid_hh_questions');
execute_query;
set_block_property('valid_hh_questions',DEFAULT_WHERE,'');
go_block('valid_hh_questions');

end;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
dt_chk boolean;
begin
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 end if;
 if eff_date < trunc(sysdate) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 end if;
 if term_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_CONTROL_BLOCK_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item = 'CTRL_BLOCK.SEARCH_FOR' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.search_for',action);
 end if; 
 if :system.cursor_item = 'CTRL_BLOCK.QUESTION_CODE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.question_code',action);
 end if; 
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_question_code',action);
 if action = 'E' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_question_code',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 end if;
END;
